reading.body:
Adobe reported $23.8 billion in annual revenue as of November 2025 and operates four commercial-use AI products across image, video, and audio generation, all trained on commercially safe data.

The company has moved AI from research into production across its core creative suite. Adobe Express AI and Adobe Firefly handle image generation. Premiere Pro AI extends this to video with generative tools for content extension and color matching. Adobe Podcast AI covers audio enhancement. Each product emphasizes commercial safety in training, a positioning that reflects Adobe's customer base of professional and enterprise users who require legal clarity on training data provenance.

This portfolio reveals how AI embeds into existing software infrastructure rather than replacing it. Adobe does not appear to offer foundation models or standalone inference services. Its AI features integrate into licensed design and video tools that already consume power and compute resources. For data center operators, this means AI workloads added to products customers already use, not new categories of demand.

The data does not cover compute spend, energy consumption, model size, or Adobe's infrastructure footprint. It does not reveal whether Adobe trains models in-house or relies on third parties. California legal exposure registers at 175 instances, but no specific disputes are documented here.

profile_text.body:
Adobe is a public company founded in 1982 and headquartered in San Jose, CA. It is listed on public markets under the ticker ADBE and reported revenue of $23,769,000,000 for the fiscal year ending November 28, 2025, according to its most recent 10-K filing. The company's website, centered on Adobe Express, describes the product as an all-in-one design, photo, and video tool intended to make content creation easy, with stated capabilities including social content, videos, and logos.

Adobe's tracked AI products span several categories. Adobe Express AI is described as a lightweight design tool with quick content creation features and integration with Adobe Firefly, which is Adobe's image generation model. Both products carry what the company describes as a commercial-safe training claim. Premiere Pro AI covers professional video editing with features the company calls generative extend and color match, also described as commercially safe. Adobe Podcast AI offers audio enhancement including speech enhancement and a microphone check feature. The site also describes an AI Assistant 2 within Adobe Express that allows users to prompt, create, and edit content while preserving chosen elements.

The held facts record 187 law exposure entries associated with California, though no specific litigation cases are currently logged against the company in this dataset. Adobe holds a CIK of 0000796343 with the SEC, confirming its status as a reporting public company.
